data.action: 在金色聚光灯下轻盈旋身挥动细剑，金鹿巨角泛光，影蛾与烛火漫天飞舞
data.camera: wide shot, low angle, majestic poise
data.description: 【薇薇安娜 · 卡西米尔大骑士领的烛火独舞】卡西米尔特锦赛决赛大竞技场中央，万众瞩目的金色聚光灯倾泻而下。薇薇安娜身披黑金礼装骑士战裙，头顶宛如珊瑚般优雅绽放的金鹿巨角流转着温润微光。她轻盈旋身挥动细剑，无数金色的微光烛火与微尘幻化为翩跹的影蛾，在竞技场漫天飞舞——「愿这微弱的烛火，能照亮长夜中每一个追求高洁的灵魂。」
data.lighting: 盛大金色竞技场聚光灯与源石光蝶微光
data.location: 卡西米尔大骑士领中央竞技场舞台
data.promptProse: In the center of the colossal Kazimierz Grand Knight arena beneath blinding golden spotlights, Viviana Droste performs her mesmerizing sword waltz. Her magnificent golden deer antlers glow with celestial warmth, framing her serene porcelain face and flowing wavy blonde hair. She pirouettes gracefully in her tailored black and gold knightly tunic armor with layered pleated skirts, raising her slender golden rapier as radiant shadow moths and swirling candle flames dance through the air. A breathtaking wide low-angle shot captures the grand arena spectacle, flying golden embers, and her peerless noble grace in pristine anime film quality.
data.title: 薇薇安娜 · 卡西米尔大骑士领的烛火独舞
